# bluetooth.listCharacteristics

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

List the characteristics of the main service.

```lua

```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `services` | table of services with handle, uuid | yes |  |
